definitions.explanation: a long pole used for hanging laundry to dry outdoors

examples.japanese: {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}に{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: To hang laundry on a drying pole.

examples.japanese: {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}が{錆|さ}びてきた。
examples.english: The laundry pole has started to rust.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{前|まえ}に{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}を{片付|かたづ}ける。
examples.english: To put away the laundry pole before a typhoon.

notes:
{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお} is a common household item in Japan where outdoor drying is standard.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {物|もの} (thing)
- {干|ほ}す (to dry)
- {竿|さお}→{竿|ざお} (pole - rendaku)

MATERIALS:
- {ステンレス|すてんれす}{製|せい} (stainless steel)
- {アルミ|あるみ}{製|せい} (aluminum)
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}{式|しき} (extendable type)

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
In Japan, most homes dry laundry outdoors on balconies or in yards using {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}. Dryers are less common than in Western countries.

RELATED TERMS:
- {物干|ものほ}し{台|だい} (laundry drying rack/stand)
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの} (laundry)
- {布団|ふとん}{干|ほ}し (futon drying)
- ハンガー (hanger)

PHRASE:
- 「{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}はいりませんか」 (famous phrase from traveling salesmen)
